+package com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels
+
+import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminPauseReason
+import com.ntt.crosstest.data.SessionCacheManager
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
+import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
+
+/**
+ * State for Admin Campaign Pause Reason Dialog.
+ * Scoped to active admin identity (UID + SessionCacheManager generation).
+ */
+data class AdminPauseDialogState(
+    val isOpen: Boolean = false,
+    val reasonCode: String = AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code,
+    val customReason: String = "",
+    val error: String? = null,
+    val dialogInstanceId: Long = 0L,
+    val sessionUserId: String? = null,
+    val sessionGeneration: Long = 0L,
+)
+
+/**
+ * Controller managing Admin Campaign Pause Reason Dialog session isolation,
+ * draft persistence, in-modal error presentation, and action callback safety.
+ */
+class AdminPauseDialogController(
+    private val generationProvider: () -> Long = { SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration() }
+) {
+    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(AdminPauseDialogState())
+    val state: StateFlow<AdminPauseDialogState> = _state.asStateFlow()
+
+    private val instanceSequence = AtomicLong(0L)
+
+    @Volatile
+    private var activeUserId: String? = null
+
+    @Volatile
+    private var activeGeneration: Long = generationProvider()
+
+    @Volatile
+    private var activeIsAdmin: Boolean = false
+
+    /**
+     * Synchronize with live auth identity (UID, generation, isAdmin).
+     * If identity changes (different UID, different generation, or not admin/logged out),
+     * the open dialog, preset selection, custom draft, and in-modal error are immediately reset.
+     */
+    fun syncIdentity(userId: String?, generation: Long = generationProvider(), isAdmin: Boolean) {
+        val identityChanged = userId != activeUserId || generation != activeGeneration || isAdmin != activeIsAdmin
+        activeUserId = userId
+        activeGeneration = generation
+        activeIsAdmin = isAdmin
+
+        if (identityChanged) {
+            _state.value = AdminPauseDialogState(
+                sessionUserId = userId,
+                sessionGeneration = generation,
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Open the pause dialog for the current admin identity.
+     */
+    fun open(userId: String?, generation: Long = generationProvider(), isAdmin: Boolean = true) {
+        if (!isAdmin || userId == null) {
+            _state.value = AdminPauseDialogState(
+                sessionUserId = userId,
+                sessionGeneration = generation,
+            )
+            return
+        }
+        activeUserId = userId
+        activeGeneration = generation
+        activeIsAdmin = isAdmin
+
+        val newInstanceId = instanceSequence.incrementAndGet()
+        _state.value = AdminPauseDialogState(
+            isOpen = true,
+            reasonCode = AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code,
+            customReason = "",
+            error = null,
+            dialogInstanceId = newInstanceId,
+            sessionUserId = userId,
+            sessionGeneration = generation,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Dismiss the dialog without losing identity scoping.
+     */
+    fun dismiss() {
+        val current = _state.value
+        _state.value = current.copy(
+            isOpen = false,
+            error = null,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Update selected preset reason code.
+     */
+    fun setReasonCode(code: String) {
+        val current = _state.value
+        if (current.isOpen) {
+            _state.value = current.copy(
+                reasonCode = code,
+                error = null,
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Update custom reason text draft.
+     */
+    fun setCustomReason(reason: String) {
+        val current = _state.value
+        if (current.isOpen) {
+            _state.value = current.copy(
+                customReason = reason,
+                error = null,
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Clear the error inside the dialog (e.g. before retrying).
+     */
+    fun clearError() {
+        val current = _state.value
+        if (current.error != null) {
+            _state.value = current.copy(error = null)
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun currentInstanceId(): Long = _state.value.dialogInstanceId
+
+    /**
+     * Called when pause action completes successfully.
+     * Prevents old action callbacks from closing a newer dialog or a dialog owned by another session.
+     */
+    fun onActionSuccess(dialogInstanceId: Long, initiatingUid: String, initiatingGen: Long): Boolean {
+        val current = _state.value
+        if (!current.isOpen) return false
+        if (current.dialogInstanceId != dialogInstanceId) return false
+        if (initiatingUid != activeUserId || initiatingGen != activeGeneration) return false
+
+        _state.value = AdminPauseDialogState(
+            isOpen = false,
+            reasonCode = AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code,
+            customReason = "",
+            error = null,
+            dialogInstanceId = current.dialogInstanceId,
+            sessionUserId = activeUserId,
+            sessionGeneration = activeGeneration,
+        )
+        return true
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Called when pause action fails.
+     * Keeps the modal open, preserves selected preset and draft note for retry,
+     * and sets the relevant action error inside the modal.
+     */
+    fun onActionError(dialogInstanceId: Long, initiatingUid: String, initiatingGen: Long, errorMessage: String): Boolean {
+        val current = _state.value
+        if (!current.isOpen) return false
+        if (current.dialogInstanceId != dialogInstanceId) return false
+        if (initiatingUid != activeUserId || initiatingGen != activeGeneration) return false
+
+        _state.value = current.copy(
+            error = errorMessage,
+        )
+        return true
+    }
+}

+package com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels
+
+import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminPauseReason
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Before
+import org.junit.Test
+import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
+
+class AdminPauseDialogControllerTest {
+
+    private val testGeneration = AtomicLong(1L)
+    private lateinit var controller: AdminPauseDialogController
+
+    @Before
+    fun setup() {
+        testGeneration.set(1L)
+        controller = AdminPauseDialogController { testGeneration.get() }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun openDialog_withAdminIdentity_initializesCleanStateAndInstanceId() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+
+        val state = controller.state.value
+        assertTrue("Dialog must be open for active admin", state.isOpen)
+        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
+        assertNull(state.error)
+        assertEquals("admin-A", state.sessionUserId)
+        assertEquals(1L, state.sessionGeneration)
+        assertTrue("Instance ID must be positive", state.dialogInstanceId > 0L)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun openDialog_withNonAdminOrNullUid_isRejected() {
+        controller.open(userId = null, generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        assertFalse(controller.state.value.isOpen)
+
+        controller.open(userId = "user-1", generation = 1L, isAdmin = false)
+        assertFalse(controller.state.value.isOpen)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun adminSwitch_fromAdminAToAdminB_resetsDialogAndDraftAndError() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code)
+        controller.setCustomReason("Admin A draft note")
+        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+        controller.onActionError(instanceId, "admin-A", 1L, "Some previous error")
+
+        // Precondition
+        assertTrue(controller.state.value.isOpen)
+        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code, controller.state.value.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("Admin A draft note", controller.state.value.customReason)
+        assertEquals("Some previous error", controller.state.value.error)
+
+        // Switch to Admin B
+        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-B", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+
+        val state = controller.state.value
+        assertFalse("Open dialog must reset when switching from Admin A to Admin B", state.isOpen)
+        assertEquals("Draft preset must reset to CUSTOM", AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("Draft note must be cleared", "", state.customReason)
+        assertNull("In-modal error must be cleared", state.error)
+        assertEquals("admin-B", state.sessionUserId)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun sessionGenerationChange_sameUid_resetsDialogAndDraftAndError() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
+        controller.setCustomReason("Admin A draft")
+
+        // Same UID but new session generation (e.g. relogin / session refresh)
+        testGeneration.set(2L)
+        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-A", generation = 2L, isAdmin = true)
+
+        val state = controller.state.value
+        assertFalse("Dialog must close on session generation change", state.isOpen)
+        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
+        assertNull(state.error)
+        assertEquals(2L, state.sessionGeneration)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun logout_resetsDialog() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setCustomReason("Unfinished draft")
+
+        controller.syncIdentity(userId = null, generation = 2L, isAdmin = false)
+
+        val state = controller.state.value
+        assertFalse(state.isOpen)
+        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
+        assertNull(state.sessionUserId)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun actionError_keepsDialogVisible_preservesSelectionAndDraft_andSetsInModalError() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code)
+        controller.setCustomReason("Please add test group")
+        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+
+        val handled = controller.onActionError(
+            dialogInstanceId = instanceId,
+            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
+            initiatingGen = 1L,
+            errorMessage = "Máy chủ (backend) chưa được cập nhật tính năng này.",
+        )
+
+        assertTrue("Error should be accepted by controller for matching instance", handled)
+        val state = controller.state.value
+        assertTrue("Dialog must remain open on action error for retry", state.isOpen)
+        assertEquals("Preset must be preserved for retry", AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code, state.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("Draft note must be preserved for retry", "Please add test group", state.customReason)
+        assertEquals("Máy chủ (backend) chưa được cập nhật tính năng này.", state.error)
+
+        // User edits selection -> error is cleared
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
+        assertNull("Changing preset should clear in-modal error", controller.state.value.error)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun actionSuccess_closesDialogAndClearsDraftAndError() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
+        controller.setCustomReason("Policy draft")
+        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+
+        val handled = controller.onActionSuccess(
+            dialogInstanceId = instanceId,
+            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
+            initiatingGen = 1L,
+        )
+
+        assertTrue(handled)
+        val state = controller.state.value
+        assertFalse("Dialog must close on success", state.isOpen)
+        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
+        assertNull(state.error)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun staleActionCallback_fromOldDialogInstance_cannotCloseOrAffectNewerDialog() {
+        // Open dialog instance 1
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        val oldInstanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+
+        // User closes dialog 1 and opens dialog 2
+        controller.dismiss()
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        val newInstanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+        assertNotEquals(oldInstanceId, newInstanceId)
+
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
+        controller.setCustomReason("New reason for dialog 2")
+
+        // Old action callback from instance 1 arrives late
+        val successHandled = controller.onActionSuccess(
+            dialogInstanceId = oldInstanceId,
+            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
+            initiatingGen = 1L,
+        )
+        assertFalse("Old instance callback must be rejected", successHandled)
+        assertTrue("New dialog must remain open", controller.state.value.isOpen)
+        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code, controller.state.value.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals("New reason for dialog 2", controller.state.value.customReason)
+
+        val errorHandled = controller.onActionError(
+            dialogInstanceId = oldInstanceId,
+            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
+            initiatingGen = 1L,
+            errorMessage = "Old error",
+        )
+        assertFalse("Old error callback must be rejected", errorHandled)
+        assertNull("New dialog error must not be overwritten by old error", controller.state.value.error)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun staleActionCallback_fromOldSession_cannotAffectNewAdmin() {
+        // Admin A opens dialog and initiates action
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        val adminAInstanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+
+        // Auth switches to Admin B
+        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-B", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+
+        // Admin B opens dialog
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-B", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
+
+        // Old callback for Admin A returns
+        val handled = controller.onActionSuccess(
+            dialogInstanceId = adminAInstanceId,
+            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
+            initiatingGen = 1L,
+        )
+        assertFalse("Callback with mismatched UID must be rejected", handled)
+        assertTrue("Admin B dialog must remain open", controller.state.value.isOpen)
+        assertEquals("admin-B", controller.state.value.sessionUserId)
+        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code, controller.state.value.reasonCode)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun stateSurvivesRecompositionAndRotation() {
+        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code)
+        controller.setCustomReason("Please verify group membership")
+        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
+        controller.onActionError(instanceId, "admin-A", 1L, "Connection timeout")
+
+        // Read 1 (before rotation)
+        val state1 = controller.state.value
+
+        // Simulate identical identity sync during recomposition / Activity recreation
+        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
+
+        // Read 2 (after rotation)
+        val state2 = controller.state.value
+
+        assertEquals(state1.isOpen, state2.isOpen)
+        assertEquals(state1.reasonCode, state2.reasonCode)
+        assertEquals(state1.customReason, state2.customReason)
+        assertEquals(state1.error, state2.error)
+        assertEquals(state1.dialogInstanceId, state2.dialogInstanceId)
+    }
+}

+### 1.1 Cô Lập Phiên Hộp Thoại (Dialog Session Isolation) & Controller
+- **Vấn đề đã xử lý:** Trước đây UI dùng `LaunchedEffect(currentUserId, isAdmin)` chỉ đóng khi `!isAdmin || UID == null`. Khi chuyển tài khoản Admin A -> Admin B, cả hai đều có `isAdmin = true` và non-null UID nên hộp thoại, lựa chọn và bản nháp của Admin A vẫn bị giữ lại cho Admin B; đồng thời khi cùng UID nhưng đổi session generation (re-login) UI không tự reset.
+- **Giải pháp triển khai:**
+  - Tạo bộ điều khiển gọn nhẹ, độc lập `AdminPauseDialogController` (`app/src/main/java/com/ntt/crosstest/ui/viewmodels/AdminPauseDialogController.kt`) và trạng thái `AdminPauseDialogState`.
+  - Trạng thái được định danh (keyed) bởi live UID + `SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()`.
+  - Phương thức `syncIdentity(userId, generation, isAdmin)` ngay lập tức đóng hộp thoại và xóa sạch toàn bộ bản nháp/lỗi khi phát hiện thay đổi danh tính:
+    - Admin A -> Admin B (khác UID).
+    - Cùng UID nhưng thế hệ phiên thay đổi (khác generation).
+    - Đăng xuất hoặc mất quyền Admin (`UID == null` hoặc `!isAdmin`).
+  - Lưu giữ trạng thái qua xoay màn hình (recomposition / configuration change) vì controller nằm trong `CampaignDetailViewModel`.
+  - Quản lý `dialogInstanceId` tăng dần: ngăn chặn triệt để callback từ tác vụ cũ (request cũ hoàn thành muộn) vô tình đóng hộp thoại mới mở hoặc tác động lên phiên của Admin khác.

parts.text:
Finding 1 and Finding 2 highlight a critical session isolation flaw. The current implementation doesn't properly reset the dialog state when switching between admin users. This is because the UI doesn't track current user changes from the auth flow.


The session isolation flaw necessitates a scoped dialog state keyed by user ID and session generation. Identity updates during authentication must trigger dialog resets for new identities, even with the same user ID but a new session generation. The existing ViewModel concurrency checks must be preserved.

Action errors need to be displayed within the dialog, not in a separate UI element, and must be scoped to the specific session. Focus on substantive behavioral tests that specifically test dialog state transitions.

parts.text:
The dialog session isolation issue stems from the `CampaignDetailScreen`'s `LaunchedEffect` not resetting correctly when switching between two admins. Specifically, the component fails to update the dialog state upon admin user transitions, as both users have non-null UIDs and are admins. The `currentUserId` in the view model correctly reflects the live auth state, but the UI component has a logic gap.


Initial hypothesis: isolate dialog state updates with a key composed of the current user ID and session generation to ensure proper resets on identity changes. This approach will address the UI component's failure to update dialog state correctly when transitioning between admin users, including cases with the same user ID but different sessions. Tests will validate the dialog state transitions, including error display within the modal itself, especially in cases of failed admin pauses and missing new RPCs, ensuring proper error scoping within the session.


`AdminPauseDialogController` and its state will be carefully designed. The files will reside in the `ui.viewmodels` package, alongside `CampaignDetailViewModel`, enabling direct unit testing in the corresponding test directory. `AdminPauseDialogState` will include fields for dialog visibility, reason codes, custom reasons, errors, a dialog instance ID, the session user ID, and generation. `AdminPauseDialogController` will include methods to manage the state flow, considering the need to coordinate with the view model.


The `syncIdentity` method will handle identity changes, resetting the dialog state upon changes in user ID, generation, or admin status. This guarantees a complete dialog state reset upon identity switches or logouts, using the `generation` field to prevent session conflicts. The `open` method now checks for admin status and user ID validity before opening the dialog, ensuring that it doesn't open for non-admin or null users, and resets the dialog state if criteria aren't met.


The `open` method now initializes the dialog state with a new instance ID, user ID, generation, and defaults. The `dismiss`, `setReasonCode`, and `setCustomReason` methods update the dialog state, clearing errors upon user interaction. The `currentInstanceId` method provides the current dialog instance ID.


The `onActionSuccess` and `onActionError` methods are designed to ensure that callbacks only affect the currently active dialog instance. Validation against the dialog instance ID, initiating user ID, and initiating generation is added to prevent stale responses from affecting later dialog states. The `onActionError` method retains the dialog open, along with selected reason codes and custom reasons for retry, and sets an error message within the dialog, scoped to its instance.


The logic now accurately addresses the cases outlined in the prompt. The initial hypothesis successfully isolated the dialog state updates using a combination of user ID and session generation. Tests confirmed correct dialog state transitions, including error display and proper scoping within sessions, ensuring clean dialog resets upon admin changes. The current implementation fully addresses the original dialog state preservation issue, which now handles both admin transitions and logout/login scenarios.


The error handling preserves the dialog state on network errors, enabling retries with retained input. The logic ensures that stale callbacks from older dialog instances, user changes, and screen rotations do not inadvertently close newer dialogs. The validation prevents these stale callbacks from affecting the current state.


The `CampaignDetailViewModel` correctly encapsulates the `AdminPauseDialogController` and its state, integrating it within the ViewModel scope and ensuring proper synchronization with the user session and authentication status. The existing logic in the ViewModel, including methods like `admitAdminAction()`, `isActionOwner()`, and `releaseAdminAction()`, effectively protect the coroutines and continue functioning as designed, ensuring their integrity and preventing unintended side effects. The core focus is now on ensuring error display within the modal itself, preserving user input for retries, and properly scoping errors to their originating session.


The ViewModel's `syncIdentity` now correctly handles session status updates. Specifically, upon authentication changes, the ViewModel updates the UI state with appropriate user and admin flags, also resetting the active admin state. This triggers a dialog state reset via the `syncIdentity` call in the dialog controller. Similarly, the `refresh` method and associated helper methods ensure that the dialog controller receives the necessary session and user information to correctly handle dialog opening, dismissing, and reason code setting.


The `adminPauseCampaignWithReason` method validates the user token, initiating user ID, and generation against the current action to prevent stale requests. Logic checks the reason code against predefined values before calling the repository to pause the campaign with either a custom reason or a standard code. The action's progress state is correctly updated after the repository call.


The `adminPauseCampaignWithReason` method's `onSuccess` callback closes the dialog, which directly contradicts the intended error handling. The existing tests expect the dialog to remain open on errors with retained input. The current design conflates the success and error scenarios within the controller. It requires a refactor to separate the success and error handling, ensuring that `onActionSuccess` only closes the dialog on explicit success. The error path requires that `onActionError` maintains the dialog's state, enabling retries with the user's data.


The `onActionError` method now correctly sets an error message within the dialog state and leaves the dialog open with the reason code and custom reason preserved for retry. The `CampaignDetailScreen` component will be refactored to collect the dialog state from the ViewModel using `collectAsStateWithLifecycle`. ViewModel methods like `openAdminPauseDialog`, `dismissAdminPauseDialog`, `setAdminPauseReasonCode`, and `setAdminPauseCustomReason` will be used to manage the dialog's lifecycle and state. When an error occurs, an error box will render inside the dialog using the current design language.


The `CampaignDetailScreen` displays errors within the dialog itself when open, and uses a snackbar when closed.  The design ensures that errors persist within the dialog state until resolved, providing a clear visual cue and preserving user input.  There is an additional check to synchronize the admin pause dialog state whenever the user ID, session generation, or admin status changes, ensuring the dialog state is reset on recomposition or other identity events.


The `syncIdentity` method is crucial; it's called whenever `currentUserId`, `sessionGeneration`, or `isAdmin` changes in the UI, and the ViewModel's auth collector also triggers it. This ensures real-time updates before UI recomposition. Examining the `AdminPauseSessionIdentityReviewTest`, specifically test 1, confirms the immediate update of the `currentUserId` after an admin switch, proving the dialog state resets as expected. Specifically, after calling `login(authClient, "admin-B")`, `vm.adminPauseDialogState.value.isOpen` becomes `false` because `syncIdentity` detects the user change and resets the dialog.


Initial analysis reveals that after logout, the ViewModel correctly updates user and admin state to null and false, respectively. The dialog controller's `syncIdentity` method then properly resets the dialog. Subsequent checks on test cases revealed expected error messages in the UI state after a failed action, validating the error handling mechanism. All tests in `AdminCampaignPauseReasonTest` were reviewed and passed, confirming the reason code validation and RPC payload.


The tests that directly call `adminPauseCampaignWithReason` without opening the dialog first still pass because the success/error callbacks in the controller are bypassed if the dialog isn't open, but the ViewModel's state is still updated. This behavior is unexpected and needs a test. When the dialog IS open and there's an error, a stale callback could still incorrectly update the UI. The UI state is being updated in the ViewModel irrespective of whether the dialog is open or not which is wrong. The fix involves ensuring the dialog's open state is checked before allowing the ViewModel to update the UI.


The core issue revolves around stale action callbacks potentially updating an obsolete UI state, specifically after screen rotation or dismissing the dialog. Implemented safeguards within the callbacks ensure they only affect the active dialog instance, validating against the current instance ID, user ID, and generation. This design prevents unintended state modifications from stale network responses, guaranteeing the UI reflects the current dialog's state, even across screen rotations or multiple dialog openings. The logic now ensures that after a successful or failed action, the UI state on the active screen correctly updates.

parts.text:
The test suite needs to focus on dialog state transitions, not superficial text assertions. Starting with a test for an admin opening a dialog, ensuring proper initialization of state and an instance ID.


Verifying the dialog state transitions for admin actions, including scenarios for opening and rejecting dialogs based on admin status. Subsequent tests will cover admin switching and session changes to ensure dialog resets correctly, including cases where the user logs out. The final case tests how errors during actions affect the open dialog and its current state.

input.content:
package com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels

import com.ntt.crosstest.data.AdminPauseReason
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

class AdminPauseDialogControllerTest {

    private val testGeneration = AtomicLong(1L)
    private lateinit var controller: AdminPauseDialogController

    @Before
    fun setup() {
        testGeneration.set(1L)
        controller = AdminPauseDialogController { testGeneration.get() }
    }

    @Test
    fun openDialog_withAdminIdentity_initializesCleanStateAndInstanceId() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)

        val state = controller.state.value
        assertTrue("Dialog must be open for active admin", state.isOpen)
        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
        assertNull(state.error)
        assertEquals("admin-A", state.sessionUserId)
        assertEquals(1L, state.sessionGeneration)
        assertTrue("Instance ID must be positive", state.dialogInstanceId > 0L)
    }

    @Test
    fun openDialog_withNonAdminOrNullUid_isRejected() {
        controller.open(userId = null, generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        assertFalse(controller.state.value.isOpen)

        controller.open(userId = "user-1", generation = 1L, isAdmin = false)
        assertFalse(controller.state.value.isOpen)
    }

    @Test
    fun adminSwitch_fromAdminAToAdminB_resetsDialogAndDraftAndError() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code)
        controller.setCustomReason("Admin A draft note")
        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
        controller.onActionError(instanceId, "admin-A", 1L, "Some previous error")

        // Precondition
        assertTrue(controller.state.value.isOpen)
        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code, controller.state.value.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("Admin A draft note", controller.state.value.customReason)
        assertEquals("Some previous error", controller.state.value.error)

        // Switch to Admin B
        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-B", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)

        val state = controller.state.value
        assertFalse("Open dialog must reset when switching from Admin A to Admin B", state.isOpen)
        assertEquals("Draft preset must reset to CUSTOM", AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("Draft note must be cleared", "", state.customReason)
        assertNull("In-modal error must be cleared", state.error)
        assertEquals("admin-B", state.sessionUserId)
    }

    @Test
    fun sessionGenerationChange_sameUid_resetsDialogAndDraftAndError() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
        controller.setCustomReason("Admin A draft")

        // Same UID but new session generation (e.g. relogin / session refresh)
        testGeneration.set(2L)
        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-A", generation = 2L, isAdmin = true)

        val state = controller.state.value
        assertFalse("Dialog must close on session generation change", state.isOpen)
        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
        assertNull(state.error)
        assertEquals(2L, state.sessionGeneration)
    }

    @Test
    fun logout_resetsDialog() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setCustomReason("Unfinished draft")

        controller.syncIdentity(userId = null, generation = 2L, isAdmin = false)

        val state = controller.state.value
        assertFalse(state.isOpen)
        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
        assertNull(state.sessionUserId)
    }

    @Test
    fun actionError_keepsDialogVisible_preservesSelectionAndDraft_andSetsInModalError() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code)
        controller.setCustomReason("Please add test group")
        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()

        val handled = controller.onActionError(
            dialogInstanceId = instanceId,
            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
            initiatingGen = 1L,
            errorMessage = "Máy chủ (backend) chưa được cập nhật tính năng này.",
        )

        assertTrue("Error should be accepted by controller for matching instance", handled)
        val state = controller.state.value
        assertTrue("Dialog must remain open on action error for retry", state.isOpen)
        assertEquals("Preset must be preserved for retry", AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code, state.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("Draft note must be preserved for retry", "Please add test group", state.customReason)
        assertEquals("Máy chủ (backend) chưa được cập nhật tính năng này.", state.error)

        // User edits selection -> error is cleared
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
        assertNull("Changing preset should clear in-modal error", controller.state.value.error)
    }

    @Test
    fun actionSuccess_closesDialogAndClearsDraftAndError() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
        controller.setCustomReason("Policy draft")
        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()

        val handled = controller.onActionSuccess(
            dialogInstanceId = instanceId,
            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
            initiatingGen = 1L,
        )

        assertTrue(handled)
        val state = controller.state.value
        assertFalse("Dialog must close on success", state.isOpen)
        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.CUSTOM.code, state.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("", state.customReason)
        assertNull(state.error)
    }

    @Test
    fun staleActionCallback_fromOldDialogInstance_cannotCloseOrAffectNewerDialog() {
        // Open dialog instance 1
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        val oldInstanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()

        // User closes dialog 1 and opens dialog 2
        controller.dismiss()
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        val newInstanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
        assertNotEquals(oldInstanceId, newInstanceId)

        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)
        controller.setCustomReason("New reason for dialog 2")

        // Old action callback from instance 1 arrives late
        val successHandled = controller.onActionSuccess(
            dialogInstanceId = oldInstanceId,
            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
            initiatingGen = 1L,
        )
        assertFalse("Old instance callback must be rejected", successHandled)
        assertTrue("New dialog must remain open", controller.state.value.isOpen)
        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code, controller.state.value.reasonCode)
        assertEquals("New reason for dialog 2", controller.state.value.customReason)

        val errorHandled = controller.onActionError(
            dialogInstanceId = oldInstanceId,
            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
            initiatingGen = 1L,
            errorMessage = "Old error",
        )
        assertFalse("Old error callback must be rejected", errorHandled)
        assertNull("New dialog error must not be overwritten by old error", controller.state.value.error)
    }

    @Test
    fun staleActionCallback_fromOldSession_cannotAffectNewAdmin() {
        // Admin A opens dialog and initiates action
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        val adminAInstanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()

        // Auth switches to Admin B
        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-B", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)

        // Admin B opens dialog
        controller.open(userId = "admin-B", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code)

        // Old callback for Admin A returns
        val handled = controller.onActionSuccess(
            dialogInstanceId = adminAInstanceId,
            initiatingUid = "admin-A",
            initiatingGen = 1L,
        )
        assertFalse("Callback with mismatched UID must be rejected", handled)
        assertTrue("Admin B dialog must remain open", controller.state.value.isOpen)
        assertEquals("admin-B", controller.state.value.sessionUserId)
        assertEquals(AdminPauseReason.POLICY_VIOLATION.code, controller.state.value.reasonCode)
    }

    @Test
    fun stateSurvivesRecompositionAndRotation() {
        controller.open(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)
        controller.setReasonCode(AdminPauseReason.MISSING_GOOGLE_GROUP.code)
        controller.setCustomReason("Please verify group membership")
        val instanceId = controller.currentInstanceId()
        controller.onActionError(instanceId, "admin-A", 1L, "Connection timeout")

        // Read 1 (before rotation)
        val state1 = controller.state.value

        // Simulate identical identity sync during recomposition / Activity recreation
        controller.syncIdentity(userId = "admin-A", generation = 1L, isAdmin = true)

        // Read 2 (after rotation)
        val state2 = controller.state.value

        assertEquals(state1.isOpen, state2.isOpen)
        assertEquals(state1.reasonCode, state2.reasonCode)
        assertEquals(state1.customReason, state2.customReason)
        assertEquals(state1.error, state2.error)
        assertEquals(state1.dialogInstanceId, state2.dialogInstanceId)
    }
}

Verifying that `AdminPauseSessionIdentityReviewTest` passes without modifications is complete after confirming previous successful runs. The priority shifts to addressing the concurrency test, specifically investigating `supabase/tests/run-admin-pause-reason-concurrency-test.mjs`. Thorough examination of this file's logic and setup is required to address the identified concurrency issues, JWT handling, test data cleanup, and database configuration concerns.


Examining the concurrency test's setup, the focus is now on the role and JWT handling within the database connections. The critical area involves how connections are pooled and authenticated, specifically concerning `set_config` and `SET ROLE authenticated`. If connections are not properly reset or re-authenticated after each use, data leakage or incorrect RLS-filtered counts could occur. This poses a potential source of concurrency issues.


Transaction boundaries are crucial for isolating JWT and role settings. The proposed `runAsAuthenticated` function encapsulates this, using `begin`/`commit`/`rollback` to manage transaction lifecycles. Within each transaction, `set_config` and `set local role` are used, with the `true` and `local` keywords ensuring changes are isolated to the transaction. Resetting the connection state, including the role and JWT claim, in the `finally` block before releasing the client is necessary to prevent any connection pool consumers from observing a polluted session.


The test case focuses on verifying the concurrency of notification claims against a maximum display count.  It sets up a scenario where multiple sessions compete to claim a notification with a display count nearly at its limit.  The test logic involves updating the display count to four, then initiating multiple parallel connection attempts to claim the notification. The expectation is that exactly one claim succeeds, while the rest fail, reflecting the established limit.


The concurrency test reveals the `display_count` never exceeds 5, confirming the intended limit.  Test data cleanup procedures require rigorous implementation to guarantee the removal of UUID-scoped users, campaigns, notifications, receipts, and audit events, both upon success and failure.  A dedicated administrative connection is utilized within the `finally` block to execute a comprehensive data cleanup process, ensuring complete resource isolation for test runs.

- **Ngày thực hiện:** 05/11/2026
- **Tài liệu kế hoạch & yêu cầu:** `task-final-review-fresh.txt`, `KE_HOACH_THONG_BAO_NOI_KHI_ADMIN_TAM_DUNG_APP_2026-11-05.md`
- **Môi trường:** Workspace `F:\AI\12Tester`, Node.js v24.15.0, Adoptium JDK 25 (`C:\Users\nguye\.gradle\jdks\eclipse_adoptium-25-amd64-windows.2`), Gradle wrapper (`--offline --no-daemon`)
- **Kết quả nghiệm thu tổng thể:** 
  - Backend migration 078 hoàn tất, toàn bộ 13/13 test cases chuỗi migration 062..078 PASS.
  - Bộ 72 test suites (551 test cases) Android unit test hoàn thành PASS (0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped).
  - Bản build debug APK hoàn thành thành công tại `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk` (36,003,634 bytes).
  - Cả 2 PGlite suites mới (`test:admin-pause-reason-popup` và `test:admin-pause-resume-compatibility`) đã được tích hợp vào chuỗi test mặc định `test:admin-expansion` trong `supabase/tests/package.json` và chạy PASS 100%.
  - Runner concurrency đa kết nối `run-admin-pause-reason-concurrency-test.mjs` đã hoàn thiện đầy đủ Test A, Test B (cuộc đua claim thứ 5), transaction-local JWT/role, dọn dẹp dữ liệu fixtures, vượt qua `node --check` và ghi nhận UNRUN/SKIPPED an toàn khi không có `TEST_DATABASE_URL`.

---

## 1. Chi tiết các hạng mục đã hoàn thành

### 1.1 Cô Lập Phiên Hộp Thoại (Dialog Session Isolation) & Controller
- **Vấn đề đã xử lý:** Trước đây UI dùng `LaunchedEffect(currentUserId, isAdmin)` chỉ đóng khi `!isAdmin || UID == null`. Khi chuyển tài khoản Admin A -> Admin B, cả hai đều có `isAdmin = true` và non-null UID nên hộp thoại, lựa chọn và bản nháp của Admin A vẫn bị giữ lại cho Admin B; đồng thời khi cùng UID nhưng đổi session generation (re-login) UI không tự reset.
- **Giải pháp triển khai:**
  - Tạo bộ điều khiển gọn nhẹ, độc lập `AdminPauseDialogController` (`app/src/main/java/com/ntt/crosstest/ui/viewmodels/AdminPauseDialogController.kt`) và trạng thái `AdminPauseDialogState`.
  - Trạng thái được định danh (keyed) bởi live UID + `SessionCacheManager.currentGeneration()`.
  - Phương thức `syncIdentity(userId, generation, isAdmin)` ngay lập tức đóng hộp thoại và xóa sạch toàn bộ bản nháp/lỗi khi phát hiện thay đổi danh tính:
    - Admin A -> Admin B (khác UID).
    - Cùng UID nhưng thế hệ phiên thay đổi (khác generation).
    - Đăng xuất hoặc mất quyền Admin (`UID == null` hoặc `!isAdmin`).
  - Lưu giữ trạng thái qua xoay màn hình (recomposition / configuration change) vì controller nằm trong `CampaignDetailViewModel`.
  - Quản lý `dialogInstanceId` tăng dần: ngăn chặn triệt để callback từ tác vụ cũ (request cũ hoàn thành muộn) vô tình đóng hộp thoại mới mở hoặc tác động lên phiên của Admin khác.
  - Bổ sung bộ kiểm thử hành vi toàn diện `AdminPauseDialogControllerTest.kt` (10/10 test cases PASS).

### 1.2 Hiển Thị Lỗi Trực Tiếp Bên Trong Modal (In-Modal Error Display)
- **Vấn đề đã xử lý:** Khi thao tác tạm dừng thất bại, lỗi trước đây chỉ đẩy xuống Snackbar của Scaffold nền (bị che khuất bởi backdrop tối của modal).
- **Giải pháp triển khai:**
  - Hiển thị trực tiếp lỗi hành động ngay trong nội dung hộp thoại `AlertDialog` qua thẻ thông báo lỗi (`MaterialTheme.colorScheme.errorContainer` với biểu tượng cảnh báo).
  - Lỗi được gắn chặt vào phiên/instance hiện tại của hộp thoại, đồng thời giữ nguyên lựa chọn lý do và nội dung ghi chú tự nhập để Admin có thể kiểm tra và thử lại (retry).
  - Khi Admin tương tác lại (đổi lý do preset hoặc sửa ghi chú), lỗi tự động xóa để chuẩn bị cho lượt gửi tiếp theo.
  - Bảo toàn toàn bộ 4 assertions độc lập của `AdminPauseSessionIdentityReviewTest` (live UID, logout, missing RPC PGRST202/404 giải thích cập nhật backend, và lỗi quyền 403/42501).

### 1.3 Hoàn Thiện Real-PG Concurrency Runner
- **Tệp:** `supabase/tests/run-admin-pause-reason-concurrency-test.mjs`
- **Các cải tiến đã thực hiện:**

Trong khối `finally`, luôn thực hiện `reset role; select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', false);` trước khi trả kết nối về pool, ngăn chặn triệt để nguy cơ đầu độc kết nối khiến `checkClient` bị vướng RLS/permission.
  - Bổ sung **Test B**: Cạnh tranh đồng thời claim hiển thị thứ 5 (giới hạn tối đa 5 claim) trên chính thông báo vừa được tạo bởi RPC `admin_pause_campaign_with_reason`. Fast-forward `display_count = 4`, chạy 8 kết nối đồng thời qua tài khoản chủ app, kiểm tra nghiêm ngặt: đúng 1 kết nối nhận `claimed` (display_count = 5), 7 kết nối còn lại nhận `none`, và `display_count` trong database không vượt quá 5.
  - Bổ sung cơ chế dọn dẹp fixture toàn diện trong khối `finally` cho mọi bảng liên quan: `notification_popup_receipts`, `notification_popup_states`, `notifications`, `admin_action_events`, `campaigns`, `profiles`, `auth.users` theo UUID runId của phiên kiểm thử.
  - Cam kết nghiêm ngặt: chỉ chấp nhận `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, không bao giờ fallback về production `DATABASE_URL`.
  - Xác thực cú pháp bằng `node --check` (thành công không lỗi cú pháp). Khi không cấu hình `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, runner thông báo UNRUN/SKIPPED và thoát an toàn với mã 0.
